comparability.averaging: all set ema_teacher=0 and swa_frac=0; final artifact is raw fixed model_ep0.pt, no EMA/SWA endpoint
comparability.common: same exact CP5 initializer, F0 source-qualified split, nested fit-component manifest, train target cache, minibatch order seed, AdamW and one-cycle schedule within each subset size
comparability.optimizer: fresh AdamW state for all three; no training-state resume

quantization_policies.input_w4_recurrent_w8: Q4 GRU weight_ih, Q8 GRU weight_hh, split head.0.weight Q8
quantization_policies.recurrent_w4: Q4 all GRU weight_ih and weight_hh; split head.0.weight Q8

comparability.weight_only: no recurrent activation quantization during training; weight-only QAT

diagnostic_limitations: The 10% and 30% fit subsets are adaptation diagnostics: their CP5 initializer and cached teachers were fitted using the complete F0 fitting membership.
All F0 groups have prior exposure; the fixed evaluation panel is a repeated development panel, not a fresh holdout.
Profiles and command recipes do not establish QAT quality or serving gains.

evaluation_ownership.latent_prediction_vectors: Optional framework-level diagnostics only; do not promote or claim served QAT quality from them.

paired_native_controls.fp32_ptq: same-subset fp32 continuation exported under uniform recurrent W4 policy
same-subset fp32 continuation exported under mixed recurrent W4/W8 policy

required_native_handoff: Export every fitted FP32, uniform-W4-QAT, and mixed-W4/W8-QAT checkpoint to the matching native archive and collect the exact archive bytes.
Export matched floating continuations through the same quantization policy (FP32-to-uniform-W4 and FP32-to-mixed-W4/W8 PTQ) for the primary paired controls.
Run the frozen evaluator on every fitted checkpoint/archive over complete trajectories and the fixed full F0 evaluation groups; retain actual callback/runtime measurements and output hashes.
Report archive size, resident weight footprint, callback/runtime, native parity, and the official metric. Weight-only framework predictions are diagnostic, not deployment quality evidence.
